name: GelSight Mini

sources.title: GelSight Mini | Tactile Sensor for Robotics (product page)
sources.covers: software support (ROS/ROS2, PyTouch); states no figures

note: An optical (elastomer and camera) tactile sensor: a contact sensor, modelled by pad coverage, not a workspace camera, so it has no imagers. pad_mm is the stated "Field of View 18.6(H) x 14.3(V) mm" of the gel. Camera resolution is stated only as "8MP" (no width and height), so camera_resolution is null and no stream is entered; frame rate 25 FPS. Gel thickness 4.25 +/- 0.20 mm; RGB LED illumination. Interface: the box contains a "2 meter USB Micro B to USB-C cable" (a USB Micro-B receptacle on the sensor); the USB generation and the stream format and data rate are not stated, so the bandwidth budget needs a measured figure. Not stated: mass, power, size (only in a drawing). Preferred operating temperature 0-30 C; the sheet's thermal test shows a 22.7 C case-temperature rise at 25 fps.

price.what: 'GelSight Mini System' (SKU GSS-R2D-00020) $510.00; includes the GelSight Mini, a standard gel, a focus tool and a USB Micro B to C cable (the GelSight Mini Robotics Package, GSS-R2D-00022, is $560.00)
